notes.title: 2024 Thinky Awards nomination
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Are you interested in puzzle games? Then be sure to check out 2024 Thinky Game Awards. The Awards page can be found [url=https://thinkygames.com/awards/]here[/url].

There are a bunch of categories, and a great set of games nominated. 2024 really was a fantastic year for puzzle games. I'm happy to anounce that The Court of Wanderers is in the race as well, as it is nominated for "Best Challenging Game"!

notes.title: Patch to 4.5.10
notes.notes: Fixed the reset on puzzle 'Reach', where one blue block woudn't be reset. My thank to Coder for pointing this out!

notes.title: Patch to version 4.5.9
notes.notes:
- Removed four untintended solutions.
- Fixed a buggy interaction between rotators and blue blocks that could occur when rapdily giving inputs.
- Fixed a problem related to the save file slots that could occur if you played the demo version of the game.

Much thanks to everyone who signalled these issues!
